en.html:
We meet up and return to the chief's residence. First tea, then some breath back in the body, then everybody's information on the table.

Three points worth noting.

One. Among the machines in today's pre-qualifying, and those that practiced afterward, not one host. Muramasa has completed the check.

Many leading teams—Tamura, Shokyo, Yokotan included—did not show themselves. For them, no clean chit. They have not been checked.

Two. Every team has put its full heart into this tournament. Seeking power? Haan, on that description we can arrest the entire pit lane. Exactly as expected.

Three. There is a fight over turning armour racing into a gambling sport.

Three. There is a fight over turning armour racing into a gambling sport.

ja.html:
合流し、署長宅へ帰着。
　茶を貰って一息つき、互いに情報を開陳する。

　着眼すべき成果は三つだった。

　一。
　今日の予備予選に参加した騎体、及びその後で練習
騎航を行った騎体の中に、寄生体は存在しない。
　村正が確認完了。

　尚、タムラや翔京、ヨコタンなど有力チームの多く
は姿を見せなかったため未確認である。

　二。
　どのチームもこの大会にかける意気込みは盛んであ
り、「力を求めている」と云い得る。
　事前の予想通り。

　三。
　装甲競技の賭博化をめぐっての対立が存在する。

en.html:
Ichijou"Gambling?"
Kageaki"Like horse racing, simply put. Sell betting tickets to the spectators and collect the money."
Kanae"I also heard that rumour. Shokyo is leading the supporters, Tamura the opposition. And behind Shokyo—"
Kageaki"Rokuhara. Shokyo's president is brother-in-law to one of the commanders serving the tournament organizer, Raichou Imagawa..."
Sayo"That appears to be the position, yes."
Ichijou"Tch. Bhookhe saale. Those jackals' hunger is running twelve months a year, fine, old news. But koi jagah toh chhodo! Even here the bastards have come sniffing for scraps!"
Kageaki"But however much Rokuhara backs them, if the customers reject it, the gambling will not stand. That is why Shokyo is putting everything into winning this tournament. Tamura, on the opposite side, is doing the same."

香奈枝「わたくしもそういう噂は聞きました。 　推進派の中心は翔京、反対派はタムラとか。 そして、翔京の背後には」

さよ「と、いうことのようでございますね」

en.html:
Kageaki"Gambling, you say. In the manner of horse racing?"
Kanae"Yes, that would seem to be the idea. Given the popularity of armour racing, the expected profits are very large indeed."
Kageaki"Certainly. But you mentioned that there is opposition?"
Kanae"Yes. From some quarters, with Tamura at the centre."
Ichijou"Why, what is their problem with it?"
Sayo"Presumably, they do not wish it to become like horse racing. Abroad may be another matter. In this country, to call horse racing a gentleman's pastime, one must be very charitable toward the word gentleman."
Ichijou"Achha, haan. They're enjoying their races. Why would they volunteer for the same gutter?"
Kageaki"Captain, how are the sides arranged? Which side has the advantage?"
Kanae"As I said, the opposition centres on Tamura. Shokyo heads the supporters, and their advantage is overwhelming. Such a brilliant halo behind them; most of the companies concerned simply lower their eyes and obey."
Ichijou"Halo?"
Kanae"Your dearly beloved Rokuhara."
Ichijou"...Heh. Paisa smells, and there go the noses. Bloody cash-sniffing jackals. Is there anywhere they won't shove their faces?"
Sayo"More specifically, they appear to have strong connections among the staff of Raichou Imagawa, the Oyumi Kubo. With His Highness the High Commander's son visible behind the arrangement, opposing it would require a certain preparedness."
Kageaki"But even with the shogunate behind it, without the spectators' support, gambling should be difficult. If the racing enthusiasts turn away from this change, bas, there ends the matter."
Kageaki"What is their answer to that difficulty?"
Kanae"This tournament is the answer, Mr. Kageaki. Win the Yamato GP the fans have been waiting for, and all that enthusiasm gathers around your team."
Sayo"Afterward, that popularity can be used to gather support for gambling. The same reasoning, naturally, is equally serviceable to the opposition."
Kageaki"...I see. Shokyo for it, Tamura against it. For both sides, this Yamato GP is where the matter will be decided."

ja.html:
景明「賭博化ですか。 　それは例えば、競馬のように」
香奈枝「ええ。そういうことなのでしょうね。 　装甲競技の人気の高さからして莫大な利益 が期待できます」
景明「確かに。 　しかし、対立があるとのお話ですが？」
香奈枝「はい。 　タムラを中心に、一部で」
一条「なんで反対してるんだ？」
さよ「それこそ、競馬のようにしたくないからで ございましょう。海外ではともかくこの国に おける競馬はなかなかに紳士の遊戯とは呼び にくいものになってしまいましたから」
一条「なるほどね。そりゃそうか。 　楽しくレースをやってる連中にしてみれば、 同じテツを踏むのは勘弁ってことだな」
景明「対立の構図及び優劣は如何なものでしょう か。大尉殿」
香奈枝「申し上げました通り反対派はタムラ中心。 　一方、推進派の中核は翔京です。圧倒的に 優勢なのはこちら側。後光の輝きが強いので、 大概の関係企業は目を伏せて従っています」
一条「後光？」
香奈枝「あなたの大好きな六波羅様」
一条「……へっ。 　金の匂いがするとどこにでも首を突っ込み やがるな、あの山犬ども」
さよ「具体的には、小弓公方今川雷蝶さまの幕僚 との間に太いパイプがある模様でございます。 　大将領殿下のご子息の姿が背後に見え隠れ していては、逆らうのも覚悟が要りましょう」
景明「しかし、背後に幕府がついていようと客層 の支持がなければ賭博化は難しい筈。 　レース愛好者たちがそのような変化に背を 向けたなら、それまでの事です」
景明「その辺りについては？」
香奈枝「だからこそこの大会なのです、景明さま。 　ファンが待ち望んだこの大和ＧＰで勝利を 収めれば、人気はそのチームに集まります」
さよ「後は、その人気を背景に賭博化への支持を 得てゆけばよろしゅうございましょう。 　もっともこれは、反対派にも同様のことが いえる理屈でございますが」
景明「……成程。 　推進派の翔京、反対派のタムラ、いずれに とってもこの大和ＧＰが天王山という事です か」

en.html:
—More or less, the situation has arranged itself.

Decisive results from our investigation: none. But whom to suspect most strongly, that much we can say.

Yesterday, a large number of unknown people. Today, a smaller number of unknown people, unknown in greater detail. Haan. Progress. The confusion has not gone away, but now we can point at the correct end of it.
